title.zh: 交通灯：设备和网页必须一致
title.en: Traffic lights: device and dashboard must agree

category.zh: 嵌入式与 Web · 状态同步

summary.zh: 修复 ESP32 交通灯、网页控制台与模拟器之间的周期逻辑、触发来源和状态同步。
summary.en: Repair cycle logic, trigger attribution, and synchronization across an ESP32 traffic light, web dashboard, and simulator.

why.zh: 红、黄、绿和行人按钮都很直观；真正的难点是让多个系统对同一次事件有一致理解。
why.en: The lights and pedestrian button are familiar; the challenge is making multiple systems agree on the same event.

visualNote.zh: 图中表示用户要求的状态与事件流，不是硬件实拍或验证通过的系统。展示摘录不含原日志中的连接配置。
visualNote.en: The diagram shows requested states and event flow, not a hardware photograph or a verified implementation. Excerpts omit connection configuration from the raw logs.

zh: 自动周期只包含绿、黄、红，不混入维护模式
维护模式只让黄灯闪烁，其余灯关闭
网页显示与设备一致，日志区分按钮和传感器触发
en: Automatic cycles contain green, amber, and red only
Maintenance flashes amber only; other lights remain off
Synchronize display and device, and distinguish button from sensor triggers

takeaway.zh: 同类问题在后续反馈中再次出现，用户最后要求逐个修复。这类任务需要跨设备、网页与日志核对证据。
takeaway.en: Similar issues recur in later feedback, and the user asks to fix them one by one. Evidence must be checked across the device, dashboard, and logs.

turns.original: corrige le probleme du cycle auto il doit pas passer a maintenance vert orange rouge seulement

title.zh: 自动周期不能混入维护模式
title.en: Keep maintenance out of normal cycles

translation.zh: 自动周期只能经过绿、黄、红；同一轮还要求维护模式只有黄灯闪烁，红灯必须关闭。
translation.en: Automatic operation must cycle through green, amber, and red only. Maintenance should flash amber while red stays off.

focus.zh: 模式和状态的边界要明确。
focus.en: Mode and state boundaries must be explicit.

turns.original: le programme ne differencie pas entre detection par distance critique du capteur et bouton poussoir physique

title.zh: 分清谁触发了行人通行

translation.zh: 程序没有区分距离传感器检测和实体按钮触发；周期日志需要显示触发来源。
translation.en: The program does not distinguish a distance-sensor detection from a physical button press. Cycle logs must identify the source.

focus.zh: 相似结果可能来自不同事件。
focus.en: Similar outcomes can originate from different events.

turns.original: lorsque j appui dans la commande du feu le bouton Demande de passage il n affiche pas declenchement par bouton il la traite normalement

title.zh: 模拟器中的按钮仍被当成普通周期
title.en: A simulated button still looks like a normal cycle

translation.zh: 运行 Python 模拟器后，点击网页“请求通行”，日志仍没有显示按钮触发。
translation.en: With the Python simulator running, clicking the web pedestrian-request button still fails to log a button-triggered event.

focus.zh: 需要端到端核对事件传递。
focus.en: Trace the event end to end.

turns.original: on procede par corriger ces erreur 1 par 1 pour ne pas compliquer la tache

title.zh: 把反复出现的问题逐个修复
title.en: Fix the recurring issues one at a time

translation.zh: 用户再次列出周期、维护灯、实机与网页同步、按钮来源四类问题，并要求逐个处理。
translation.en: The user again lists cycle, maintenance-light, device/dashboard synchronization, and button-source issues, asking to address them one at a time.

focus.zh: 问题收敛与协作节奏同样重要。
focus.en: Issue convergence and collaboration pace both matter.

source.note: Source indices identify historical messages, not benchmark evaluation rounds. Translations and display summaries are editorial.
